gloss: how to handle; way of treating; manner of use
notes:
A versatile compound noun that can refer to handling physical objects (tools, machines), managing data or information, or treating people. Formed with the productive pattern of verb stem + {方|かた} (way of doing).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {扱|あつか}い{方|かた}がうまい: to be good at handling
- {扱|あつか}い{方|かた}を{間違|まちが}える: to mishandle
- {扱|あつか}い{方|かた}を{知|し}る: to know how to handle
- {扱|あつか}い{方|かた}が{荒|あら}い: to handle roughly
- {扱|あつか}い{方|かた}に{困|こま}る: to be at a loss for how to deal with

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {使|つか}い{方|かた}: how to use — specifically about operating or using something
- {対処法|たいしょほう}: coping method — focuses on dealing with problems or difficult situations
- {取|と}り{扱|あつか}い: handling, treatment — a more formal synonym, often used in instructions and manuals

ETYMOLOGY:
Composed of {扱|あつか}い (handling, from the verb {扱|あつか}う) + {方|かた} (way, method).

definitions.gloss: how to handle; way of treating; manner of use
definitions.explanation: the method or manner of handling, treating, or dealing with something or someone

examples.japanese: この{機械|きかい}の{扱|あつか}い{方|かた}を{教|おし}えてください。
examples.english: Please teach me how to use this machine.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}の{扱|あつか}い{方|かた}がうまい{人|ひと}だ。
examples.english: That person is good at handling children.

examples.japanese: データの{扱|あつか}い{方|かた}を{間違|まちが}えると{大|おお}きな{問題|もんだい}になる。
examples.english: If you mishandle data, it will become a big problem.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{部下|ぶか}の{扱|あつか}い{方|かた}が{荒|あら}いと{評判|ひょうばん}だ。
examples.english: He has a reputation for treating his subordinates roughly.
